author: KEXP
description:
Seattle-based Americana band The Brudi Brothers join John Richards Live on KEXP to share their distinctive old-world sound. 

Watch them perform “Me More Cowboy Than You” and more at our channel and subscribe for more music discovery.
title: The Brudi Brothers perform "Me More Cowboy Than You" Live on KEXP
